INNER JOIN [HotelRooms] AS [h] ON [p].[RoomId] = [h].[RoomId]
INNER JOIN [RoomTypes] AS [r] ON [h].[RoomTypeId] = [r].[RoomTypeId]
WHERE DATEPART(year, [p].[BookingDate]) = @__year_0 AND [p].[Status] <> 2
GROUP BY [r].[RoomTypeId], [r].[Name]
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
